header: Every route to you, as cards or as rows
subheader: Chat, phone, email, the help centre, the status page, the counter.
lead: One variant gives each channel a card, the other a row with a rule under it. Nothing else about an entry changes between the two.
note: Use real protocol links so a phone opens the dialler, and keep hours in each entry rather than in this shared note.
